Tua-Seen-Meem
yeh uss kitab ki aayaten hain jo haq ko wazeh kernay wali hai .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) shayad tum iss ghum mein apni jaan halak kiye jarahey ho kay yeh log emaan ( kiyon ) nahi latay !
agar hum chahen to inn/unn per aasman say koi aesi nishani utaar den kay uss kay aagay inn ki gardanen jhuk ker reh jayen .
. ( inn ka haal to yeh hai kay ) inn kay paas khudaye rehman ki taraf say jo koi naee naseehat aati hai , yeh uss say mun morr letay hain .
iss tarah unhon ney haq ko jhutla diya hai . chunacheh yeh log jinn baaton ka mazaq uratay rahey hain , abb unqareeb unn kay theek theek haqaeeq inn kay samney aajayen gay .
aur kiya unhon ney zameen ko nahi dekha kay hum ney iss mein her nafees qisam ki kitni cheezen ugai hain-?
yaqeenan inn sabb cheezon mein ibrat ka bara saman hai , phir bhi inn mein say aksar log emaan nahi latay ,
aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , boht meharban bhi .
aur uss waqt ka haal suno jab tumharay perwerdigar ney musa ko aawaz dey ker kaha tha kay :  uss zalim qoam kay paas jao ,
yani firon ki qoam kay paas . kiya unn kay dil mein khuda ka khof nahi hai ?
musa ney kaha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay jhoota banayen gay .
aur mera dil tang honey lagta hai , aur meri zaban nahi chalti . iss liye aap Haroon ko bhi ( nabwooat ka ) paygham bhej dijiye .
aur meray khilaf inn logon  ney aik jurm bhi aaeed ker rakha hai ,   jiss ki wajeh say mujhay darr hai kay woh mujhay qatal naa ker daalen .
Allah ney farmaya kay :  hergiz nahi ! tum dono humari nishaniyan ley ker jao . yaqeen rakho kay hum tumharay sath hain , sari baaten suntay rahen gay .
abb tum dono firon kay paas jao , aur kaho kay :  hum dono Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay payghumber hain
. ( aur yeh paygham laye hain ) kay tum bano Israel ko humaray sath bhej do .

firon ney ( jawab mein musa ( aleh-assalam ) say ) kaha :  kiya hum ney tumhen uss waqt apney paas rakh ker nahi paala tha jab tum bilkul bacchay thay ?   aur tum ney apni umar kay boht say saal humaray yahan reh ker guzaray ,
aur jo harkat tum ney ki thi woh bhi ker guzray ,   aur tum baray nashukray aadmi ho .
musa ney kaha :  uss waqt woh kaam mein aesi halat mein ker guzra tha kay mujhay pata nahi tha .
chunacheh jab mujhay tum logon  say khof huwa to mein tumharay paas say farar hogaya , phir Allah ney mujhay hikmat ata farmaee , aur payghumberon mein shamil farma diya .
aur woh ehsan jo tum mujh per rakh rahey ho , ( uss ki haqeeqat ) yeh hai kay tum ney saray bano Israel ko ghulam bana rakha hai .
firon ney kaha :  aur yeh Rabb-ul-Aalameen kiya cheez hai-?
musa ney kaha :  woh saray aasmano aur zameen ka , aur unn sari cheezon ka perwerdigar hai jo unn kay darmiyan pai jati hain , agar tum ko waqaee yaqeen kerna ho .
firon ney apney ird-gird kay logon  say kaha :  sunn rahey ho kay nahi-?
musa ney kaha :  woh tumhara bhi perwerdigar hai , aur tumharay pichlay baap dadon ka bhi .
firon bola :  tumhara yeh payghumber jo tumharay paas bheja gaya hai , yeh to bilkul hi deewana hai .
musa ney kaha :  woh mashriq o maghrib ka bhi perwerdigar hai , aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ka bhi , agar tum aqal say kaam lo .
kehney laga :  yaad rakho , agar tum ney meray siwa kissi aur ko mabood maana to mein tumhen zaroor unn logon  mein shamil kerdun ga jo jail khaney mein parray huye hain .
musa bolay :  aur agar mein tumhen koi aesi cheez laa dikhaon jo haq ko wazeh ker dey , phir-?
firon ney kaha :  acha , agar waqaee sachay ho to ley aao woh cheez .
chunacheh musa ney apna assa phenka , aur dekhtay hi dekhtay woh khula huwa azdaha ban gaya ,
aur unhon ney apna haath ( baghal mein say ) kheench ker nikala to pal bhar mein woh sabb dekhney walon kay samney safaid hogaya .
firon ney apney irdgird kay sardaron say kaha :  yaqeenan yeh koi mahir jadoogar hai .
yeh chahta hai kay apney jadoo kay zariye tumhen tumhari sarzameen say nikal bahir keray . abb batao tumhari kiya raye hai ?
unhon ney kaha :  inn ko aur inn kay bhai ko kuch mohlat dijiye , aur tamam shehron mein herkaray bhej dijiye .
jo har mahir jadoogar ko aap kay paas ley ayen ( aur inn jadoogaron ka muqabla keren )
chunacheh aik din muqarrara waqt per saray jadoogar jama kerliye gaye .
aur logon  say kaha gaya kay :  kiya tum log jama horahey ho-?
shayad agar yeh jadoogar hi ghalib aagaye to hum inhi kay raastay per chalen .
phir jab jadoogar aaye to unhon ney firon say kaha :  yeh baat to yaqeeni hai naa kay agar hum ghalib aagaye to hamen koi inaam milay ga-?
firon ney kaha :  haan haan , aur tumhen uss soorat mein muqarrab logon  mein bhi zaroor shamil kerliya jaye ga .
musa ney unn jadoogaron say kaha :  jo kuch tumhen phenkna hai , phenko .
iss per unn jadoogaron ney apni rassiyan aur lathiyan zameen per daal den ,   aur kaha kay :  firon ki izzat ki qasam ! hum hi hum ghalib ayen gay .
abb musa ney apna asaa zameen per daala to achanak uss ney ( azdaha ban ker ) uss tamashay ko nigalna shuroo kerdiya jo woh jhoot moott bana rahey thay .
bus phir woh jadoogar sajday mein gira diye gaye .
kehney lagay kay :  hum Rabb-ul-Aalameen per emaan ley aaye ,
jo musa aur Haroon ka perwerdigar hai .

firon bola :  tum meray ijazat denay say pehlay hi musa per emaan ley aaye . sabit huwa kay yeh tum sabb ka sarghana hai jiss ney tumhen jadoo sikhaya hai . acha abhi tumhen pata chal jaye ga . mein tum sabb kay aik taraf kay haath aur doosri taraf kay paon katwaon ga , aur tum sabb ko sooli per latka dun ga .
jadoogaron ney kaha :  humara kuch nahi bigrey ga , hamen yaqeen hai kay hum loat ker apney perwerdigar kay paas chalay jayen gay .
hum to shoq say umeed lagaye huye hain kay humara perwerdigar iss wajeh say humari khatayen bakhsh dey ga kay hum sabb say pehlay emaan laye thay .
aur hum ney musa kay paas wahi bheji kay :  meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao , tumhara peecha yaqeenan kiya jaye ga .
iss per firon ney shehron mein herkaray bhej diye
. ( aur yeh kehla bheja kay : )  yeh ( bani Israel ) aik choti si toli kay thoray say log hain .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay enhon ney humaray dil jalaye huye hain ,
aur hum sabb ehtiyati tadbeeren kiye huye hain ( lehaza sabb milker inn ka taaqqub kero )
iss tarah hum unhen bahir nikal laye baaghon aur chashmon say bhi .
aur khazanon aur ba-izzat maqamaat say bhi .
inn ka moamla to issi tarah huwa , aur ( doosri taraf ) unn cheezon ka waris hum ney bani Israel ko bana diya .
gharz huwa yeh kay yeh sabb log sooraj nikaltay hi unn ka peecha kernay nikal kharray huye .
phir jab dono jathay aik doosray ko nazar aaney lagay to musa kay sathiyon ney kaha kay :  abb to pakki baat hai kay hum pakar hi liye gaye .
musa ney kaha :  hergiz nahi , meray sath yaqeeni tor say mera perwerdigar hai , woh mujhay raasta bataye ga .
chunacheh hum ney musa kay paas wahi bheji kay apni laathi samandar per maaro . bus phir samandar phatt gaya , aur her hissa aik baray pahar ki tarah kharra hogaya .
aur doosray fareeq ko bhi hum uss jagah kay nazdeek ley aaye .
aur musa aur unn kay tamam sathiyon ko hum ney bachaliya ,
phir doosron ko gharq ker daala .
yaqeenan iss saray waqaey mein ibrat ka bara saman hai , phir bhi inn mein say aksar log emaan nahi latay ,
aur yaqeen rakho kay tumhara perwerdigar sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , bara meharban bhi .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko Ibrahim ka waqiaa sunao ,
jab unhon ney apney baap aur apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  tum kiss cheez ki ibadat kertay ho-?
unhon ney kaha kay :  hum button ki ibadat kertay hain , aur unhi kay aagay dharna diye rehtay hain .
Ibrahim ney kaha :  jab tum unn ko pukartay ho to kiya yeh tumhari baat suntay hain-?
ya tumhen koi faeeda ya nuqsan phonchatay hain-?
unhon ney kaha :  asal baat yeh hai kay hum ney apney baap dadon ko aisa hi kertay huye paya hai .
Ibrahim ney kaha :  bhala kabhi tum ney inn cheezon ko ghor say dekha bhi jinn ki tum ibadat kertay rahey ho-?
tum bhi aur tumharay puraney baap daday bhi !
meray liye to yeh sabb dushman hain , siwaye aik Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay
jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai , phir wohi meri rehnumai farmata hai ,
aur jo mujhay khilata pilata hai
aur jab mein beemar hota hun to mujhay shifa deta hai ,
aur jo mujhay moat dey ga , phir zinda keray ga ,
aur jiss say mein yeh umeed lagaye huye hun kay woh hisab o kitab kay din meri khata bakhsh dey ga .
meray perwerdigar ! mujhay hikmat ata farma , aur mujhay naik logon  mein shamil farmaley ,
aur aaney wali naslon mein meray liye woh zabanen peda farmadey jo meri sachai ki gawahi den .
aur mujhay unn logon  mein say bana dey jo naimaton wali jannat kay waris hon gay .
aur meray baap ki maghfirat farma . yaqeenan woh gumrah logon  mein say hai .
aur uss din mujhay ruswa naa kerna jiss din logon  ko dobara zinda kiya jaye ga ,
jiss din naa koi maal kaam aaye ga , naa aulad ,
haan jo shaks Allah kay paas salamti wala dil ley ker aaye ga , ( uss ko nijat milay gi )
aur jannat muttaqi logon  kay liye qareeb kerdi jaye gi ,
aur dozakh khulay tor per gumrahon kay samney kerdi jaye gi
aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  kahan hain woh jinn ki tum Allah ko chorr ker ibadat kiya kertay thay ?
kiya woh tumhari madad keren gay ya khud apna bachao kerlen gay-?
phir unn ko aur gumrahon ko bhi ondhay mun dozakh mein daal diya jaye ga ,
aur iblees kay saray lashkaron ko bhi .
wahan yeh sabb aapas mein jhagarrtay huye ( apney maboodon say ) kahen gay
kay :  Allah ki qasam hum to uss zamaney mein khuli gumrahi mein mubtala thay .
jab hum ney tumhen Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay barabar qarar dey rakha tha .
aur hamen to inn baray baray mujrimon ney hi gumrah kiya tha .
nateeja yeh hai kay naa to hamen kissi qisam ki sifarish kernay walay moyassar hain
aur naa koi aisa dost jo hamdardi ker-sakay .
abb kaash kay hamen aik martaba duniya mein wapis janey ka moaqa mil jaye to hum momin ban jayen !

nooh ney kaha :  mein kiya janon kay woh kiya kaam kertay hain-?
unn ka hisab lena kissi aur ka nahi , meray perwerdigar ka kaam hai .   kaash ! tum samajh say kaam lo .
aur mein inn mominon ko dhutkar ker apney say door nahi ker-sakta .

beyshak yeh Quran Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka nazil kiya huwa hai .
amanat daar farishta issay ley ker utra hai
. ( aey payghumber ! ) tumharay qalb per utra hai takay tum unn ( payghumberon ) mein shamil hojao jo logon  ko khabrdar kertay hain ,
aesi arbi zaban mein utra hai jo paygham ko wazeh ker-denay wali hai .
aur iss ( Quran ) ka tazkarah pichli ( aasmani ) kitabon mein bhi mojood hai .
bhala kiya inn logon  kay liye yeh koi daleel nahi hai kay bano Israel kay ulama iss say waqif hain-?
aur agar hum yeh kitab ajmi logon  mein say kissi per nazil ker-detay ,
aur woh inn kay samney parh bhi deta to yeh log tab bhi uss per emaan naa latay .
mujrimon kay dilon mein to hum ney iss ko issi tarah dakhil kiya hai ,
yeh log iss per uss waqt tak emaan nahi layen gay jab tak dardnak azab aankhon say naa dekh len ,
aur woh unn kay paas iss tarah achanak aa-khara ho kay inn ko pata bhi naa chalay ,
phir yeh keh uthen kay kiya hamen kuch mohlat mil sakti hai ?
to kiya yeh log humaray azab kay liye jaldi macha rahey hain-?
bhala batao agar hum kaee saal tak enhen aesh ka saman mohaiyya kertay rahen ,
phir woh ( azab ) inn kay oopper aa-khara ho jiss say enhen daraya jaraha hai .
to aesh ka jo saman inn ko diya jata raha woh enhen ( azab kay waqt ) kiya faeeda phoncha sakta hai ?
aur hum ney kissi basti ko iss kay baghair halak nahi kiya kay ( pehlay ) uss kay liye khabrdar kernay walay mojood thay ,
takay woh naseehat keren , aur hum aesay to nahi hain kay zulm keren .
aur iss Quran ko shayateen ley ker nahi utray ,
naa yeh Quran unn kay matlab ka hai , aur naa woh aisa ker-saktay hain ,
unhen to ( wahi kay ) sunney say bhi rok diya gaya hai .
lehaza Allah kay sath koi mabood naa maano , kabhi tum bhi unn logon  mein shamil hojao jinhen azab hoga .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum apney qareeb tareen khandan ko khabrdar kero ,
aur jo momin tumharay peechay chalen , unn kay liye inkisari kay sath apni shafqat ka bazoo jhuka do ,
aur agar woh tumhari nafarmani keren to keh do kay :  jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , uss say mera koi talluq nahi .
aur uss ( Allah ) per bharosa rakho jo bara iqtidar wala , boht meharban hai .
jo tumhen uss waqt bhi dekhta hai jab tum ( ibadat kay liye ) kharray hotay ho ,
aur sajda kernay walon kay darmiyan tumhari aamd-o-raft ko bhi dekhta hai ,
yaqeen rakho kay wohi hai jo her baat sunta her cheez janta hai
kiya mein tumhen bataon kay shayateen kinn logon  per utartey hain-?
woh her aesay shaks per utartey hain jo perlay darjay ka jhoota gunehgaar ho ,
woh suni sunai baat laa daaltay hain ,   aur unn mein say aksar jhootay hotay hain .
rahey shaeer log , to unn kay peechay to bey raah log chaltay hain .
kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay woh her wadi mein bhataktay phirtay hain-?
aur yeh kay woh aesi baaten kehtay hain jo kertay nahi hain ,

haan magar woh log mustasna hain jo emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , aur Allah ko kasrat say yaad kiya , aur apney oopper zulm honey kay baad uss ka badla liya .   aur zulm kernay walon ko unqareeb pata chal jaye ga kay woh kiss anjam ki taraf palat rahey hain .
